STRAWBERRY SHORTCAKE SCANDAL: A CLOVER CRUMBLE COZY MYSTERY (BOOK #1) is the first book in a new cozy mystery series by Fiona Grace, #1 bestselling author of Murder in the Manor, which has over 10,000 five star reviews!

When Clover Crumble trades her old life for a fresh start, converting an old farmhouse into a cake boutique, she imagines her biggest problems will be perfecting her buttercream and winning over skeptical locals.

But when a bride-to-be turns up dead the morning of her wedding, the night after sampling Clover's confections, her charming new beginning takes a very dark turn.

With suspicion swirling and a guest list full of jealous relatives and scorned exes, Clover finds herself doing a lot more than baking.

To make matters worse, the local handyman fixing her farmhouse shutters is exactly the kind of complication she promised herself she didn't need right now.

The CLOVER CRUMBLE mystery series takes readers on a wild ride in her farmhouse cake boutique, where the wedding cakes are works of art, the romance is always in the air, and somehow, someone always ends up dead before the vows are exchanged. Charming, funny, and impossible to put down, this is the series for anyone who likes their mysteries with a generous helping of sweetness, and just a dash of chaos.

Future books in the series are also available!
